name: Vodou Memory (for your IDE)
description: Give Cursor, VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, or Claude Desktop vault-scoped access to your Vodou memory — memory_search, memory_context, and remember tools, limited to your portable vault.

setupSteps.title: Curate your portable vault
setupSteps.instructions: Only the portable vault is ever visible to external tools. Review what's in it: ./vodou-core mem vault preview portable, or curate visually in the Brain console's vault manager. Add/remove chunks with mem vault include/exclude.
setupSteps.gotcha: Everything in this vault can appear inside your IDE's AI chat. Nothing outside it ever will.

setupSteps.title: Visual Studio (Copilot Chat)
setupSteps.instructions: Solution-level .mcp.json (same shape as VS Code's mcp.json servers block). Visual Studio picks it up in Copilot Chat's agent mode tool list.

setupSteps.title: JetBrains / Windsurf / Zed
setupSteps.instructions: Same stdio command in each tool's MCP settings: JetBrains AI Assistant → Settings → Tools → AI Assistant → MCP; Windsurf → ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json; Zed → context servers in settings.json.
setupSteps.gotcha: Claude Code needs nothing here — the Vodou SessionStart hook already injects memory.

notes.auth: No credentials — talks only to your local vodou-core binary and gateway (127.0.0.1). The vault name is fixed at launch; tools cannot request a different vault.
